title: Stereoisomer Chirality Mirror Comparison Tool
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js that implements an interactive stereoisomer chirality mirror comparison tool for studying molecular chirality. The scene uses a soldier.glb model as a 3D mascot/guide figure positioned to the side.

SCENE SETUP:
- Use a dark background (0x1a1a2e) with a WebGLRenderer, antialiased, sized to the full window.
- PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 5, 18), looking at origin.
- Add AmbientLight (0xffffff, 0.5) and two DirectionalLights: one from (5,10,7) intensity 0.8, one from (-5,10,-7) intensity 0.4.
- Load 'soldier.glb' using GLTFLoader from CDN (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js). Scale the soldier model to 0.02 and position it at (10, -4, 0). It serves as a decorative lab assistant figure. Store reference in window.__3D_STATE__.soldierLoaded = true once loaded.
- Add OrbitControls from CDN for camera manipulation.
- A translucent vertical mirror plane (PlaneGeometry 8x10, MeshPhysicalMaterial with opacity 0.15, metalness 0.9, roughness 0.1, color 0x88ccff, side DoubleSide) at x=0, acting as the chirality mirror.

MOLECULE SYSTEM:
- Implement a molecule builder that creates tetrahedral chiral molecules using spheres (atoms) and cylinders (bonds).
- The tool has a library of 4 chiral molecules selectable by the user:
  1. 'Alanine' - central carbon (gray 0x555555), with NH2 (blue 0x3333ff), COOH (red 0xff3333), CH3 (green 0x33ff33), H (white 0xffffff)
  2. 'Glyceraldehyde' - central C (gray), OH (red), CHO (orange 0xff8833), CH2OH (cyan 0x33ffff), H (white)
  3. 'Lactic Acid' - central C (gray), OH (red), COOH (red darker 0xcc2222), CH3 (green), H (white)
  4. 'Bromochlorofluoromethane' - central C (gray), Br (brown 0x883300), Cl (green 0x00cc00), F (yellow 0xffff00), H (white)
- Each molecule is built as a THREE.Group. Atom spheres radius 0.4 for substituents, 0.5 for central. Bond cylinders radius 0.08.
- Tetrahedral geometry: place 4 substituents at proper tetrahedral angles (109.5°) around the central atom at distance 2.0 from center.
- The LEFT side (x < 0) shows the R-enantiomer, centered at (-5, 1, 0).
- The RIGHT side (x > 0) shows the S-enantiomer (mirror image), centered at (5, 1, 0).
- The S-enantiomer must be a TRUE mirror reflection of the R-enantiomer: negate the x-coordinates of all substituent positions relative to center.

CHIRALITY ANALYSIS ENGINE:
- Implement CIP priority assignment: each substituent gets a priority number 1-4 based on atomic number of the attached atom (higher atomic number = higher priority).
- Compute the chirality designation (R or S) by checking the orientation of priorities 1→2→3 when viewed from opposite the lowest priority group (priority 4). Clockwise = R, counterclockwise = S.
- Store the computed designation and verify it matches the expected label.
- window.__3D_STATE__.chiralityCorrect must be true when R and S are properly assigned.

INTERACTION - MOLECULE SELECTION:
- A DOM select dropdown with id='moleculeSelect' containing the 4 molecules. Changing selection rebuilds both enantiomers.
- window.__3D_STATE__.currentMolecule stores the name string of the active molecule.

INTERACTION - ROTATION:
- Both molecules can be independently rotated around their Y-axis using keyboard:
  - 'Q'/'E' rotate the LEFT (R) molecule by ±15° (±Math.PI/12).
  - 'U'/'O' rotate the RIGHT (S) molecule by ±15°.
- Store rotations: window.__3D_STATE__.leftRotationY and window.__3D_STATE__.rightRotationY in radians.

INTERACTION - SUPERIMPOSE TEST:
- A button with id='superimposeBtn' labeled 'Superimpose Test'. When clicked, animate both molecules to the center (x=0, y=1, z=2) over 1 second. After arriving, compute an overlap score (0-100) based on how well substituent positions match. True enantiomers should NOT superimpose (score < 30). Store in window.__3D_STATE__.overlapScore.
- A button with id='resetPositionsBtn' to move them back to original positions.
- window.__3D_STATE__.isSuperimposed tracks the boolean state.

INTERACTION - HIGHLIGHT SUBSTITUENT:
- Clicking on any substituent sphere highlights it with emissive color (0xffff00) and shows its CIP priority in a DOM div with id='priorityDisplay'.
- window.__3D_STATE__.selectedSubstituent stores {name, priority, side} or null.
- Raycasting must be used for click detection on atoms.

INTERACTION - MIRROR TOGGLE:
- A button with id='mirrorToggleBtn' toggles the mirror plane visibility.
- window.__3D_STATE__.mirrorVisible boolean.

INTERACTION - SWAP SUBSTITUENTS (UNDO/REDO):
- A button with id='swapBtn': swaps the positions of the two highest-priority substituents on the LEFT molecule, which changes R to S. This demonstrates that swapping any two groups inverts chirality.
- A button with id='undoSwapBtn': undoes the last swap, restoring original chirality.
- window.__3D_STATE__.swapCount tracks number of swaps performed (each swap increments, undo decrements).
- window.__3D_STATE__.leftChirality stores 'R' or 'S' for the left molecule's current designation.

INTERACTION - BOND ANGLE MEASUREMENT:
- Press 'M' to enter measurement mode. In measurement mode, clicking two substituents on the same molecule displays the bond angle between them (through the central atom) in a div with id='angleDisplay'.
- window.__3D_STATE__.measurementMode boolean.
- window.__3D_STATE__.measuredAngle stores the last measured angle in degrees.

HUD/UI:
- Top bar: molecule selector dropdown, superimpose button, reset button, mirror toggle button, swap button, undo button.
- Bottom left: div id='priorityDisplay' showing selected atom info.
- Bottom right: div id='angleDisplay' showing measured angle.
- Top right: div id='chiralityLabels' showing 'R-enantiomer' and 'S-enantiomer' labels that update if chirality changes after swap.
- All buttons styled with dark theme (background 0x2a2a4a, white text, rounded).

STATE OBJECT (window.__3D_STATE__):
{
  soldierLoaded: bool,
  currentMolecule: string,
  leftRotationY: number (radians),
  rightRotationY: number (radians),
  overlapScore: number (0-100),
  isSuperimposed: bool,
  selectedSubstituent: {name:string, priority:number, side:string} | null,
  mirrorVisible: bool,
  chiralityCorrect: bool,
  swapCount: number,
  leftChirality: string ('R' or 'S'),
  rightChirality: string ('R' or 'S'),
  measurementMode: bool,
  measuredAngle: number (degrees),
  moleculeCount: number (always 4),
  atomCountPerMolecule: number (5 - central + 4 substituents),
  tetrahedralAngle: number (approximately 109.47)
}

Ensure all state fields are initialized at startup. Use requestAnimationFrame for the render loop. All angles must be computed with proper 3D vector math. The mirror reflection must be geometrically accurate (x-negation of substituent local positions).
physics_constraints: Tetrahedral bond angles must be approximately 109.47° (±1°). Mirror reflection must be exact x-negation of substituent positions. CIP priority assignment must follow atomic number rules. Chirality designation must follow CIP rules (R=clockwise, S=counterclockwise when viewed from opposite lowest priority). Swapping any two substituents must invert chirality. True enantiomers must not be superimposable (overlap score < 30). Bond lengths must remain constant at 2.0 units. All rotations must preserve molecular geometry.
